scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted a conventional loan application for a home purchase, and I haven’t heard back yet. Could you tell me the status of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still being reviewed?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your conventional home purchase loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have further questions about your loan details or next steps, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for letting me know that my loan was approved—that’s great to hear!

Could you please tell me what interest rate I was assigned, as well as the total costs associated with the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your approved loan has an interest rate of 6.062%. The total costs associated with the loan are $3,602.48. If you need clarification on either of these details or have additional questions, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing those details. I have two more questions:

1. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on this loan?
2. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution yet?
dialogue.agent:
1. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.
2. Your loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution; it remains with the original lender at this time.

dialogue.user:
That’s very helpful—thank you for answering my questions so clearly and promptly.

Overall, I feel well informed about my application and the loan terms. I appreciate the straightforward explanations and that you addressed all my concerns.

<Satisfied> 

My reasoning: The agent was competent and clear, provided all the information I asked for, and was courteous throughout the conversation. I got all the answers I needed without any confusion.
